cd /workspace && timeout 300 python3 -c "
import sys, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import t4
from planner import *
from fcflow import FlowGraph
seed=29
rnd=random.Random(seed)
n,links,caps,parts,rdem0=t4.gen(rnd)
period=rnd.choice([1,3,1000])
envelope={i:min(c,10**12) for i,c in enumerate(caps) if c>0}
cpl=[period*envelope.get(i,0) for i in range(len(links))]
cap={}
for lid,(u,v) in enumerate(links):
    if cpl[lid]>0:
        cap[(u,v)]=cap.get((u,v),0)+cpl[lid]; cap[(v,u)]=cap.get((v,u),0)+cpl[lid]
k=t4.max_multiplier(n,cap,parts,rdem0)
rdem={v:rdem0[v]*k for v in parts}
total=sum(rdem.values())
P=sorted(parts)
print('participants',P,'r',rdem,'D',total)
# for each v, min cut with SOURCE->b caps r_b, sink v
for v in P:
    g=FlowGraph(n+2); SRC=n; SNK=n+1
    for (a,b),c in cap.items():
        if c>0: g.add_arc(a,b,c)
    for b in P: g.add_arc(SRC,b,rdem[b])
    g.add_arc(v,SNK,1<<200)
    val,reach=g.maxflow(SRC,SNK,want_cut=True)
    S=[i for i in range(n) if reach[i]]
    inter=[x for x in S if x in set(P)]
    cut=sum(c for (a,b),c in cap.items() if a in set(S) and b not in set(S))
    print('sink',v,'flow',val,'S∩C',inter,'phys cut',cut,'r(S)',sum(rdem[x] for x in inter))
print('links', sorted([(u,v,cap[(u,v)]) for (u,v) in cap if u<v]))
" 2>&1 | tail -10
